summary: Seabridge Gold Inc. filed a 6-K including a Letter of Transmittal and Proxy Circular for a statutory arrangement under the Canada Business Corporations Act. At a special meeting scheduled for May 22, 2026, shareholders will vote on a plan whereby each Seabridge share will be exchanged for one new Seabridge share plus a pro-rata portion of 55,000,000 Valor Shares held by Seabridge, effectively distributing shares of its wholly-owned subsidiary Valor Gold Corp. to existing shareholders. The transaction involves a spin-off of Valor shares via an arrangement, not a cash consideration. Shareholders must submit shares via the Letter of Transmittal to receive the entitlement. The filing includes a technical report and consents. The close is conditional on shareholder approval and regulatory steps. Watch for shareholder dissent rights and the spin-off mechanics.
